name: 可操作伸缩隔离带套件
description: 双立柱、柔性带身、可抓取端头与卡扣；支持抬起脱扣、受控回收、拉出扣回
upstream_origin: FQ authored research prototype; no vendor CAD or calibrated mechanism
license_status: Project-authored concept geometry and code; see NOTICE.md
limitations: MuJoCo 3.3.6 native 2D flex webbing only; USD and web 3D are static visual snapshots
Reel feed is a prescribed spiral boundary with rate limiting, not spring torque or motor dynamics
Grasp, docking and latch use checked explicit constraints; not friction-only manipulation or vendor latch replication
Internal webbing self-collision is disabled; reel-layer packing/friction is not validated
Dimensions, materials, masses and contact forces are assumed, not calibrated
Guide gripper fixture is included; no robot policy, perception or complete passenger workflow
viewer_status: 246 顶点，原生 MuJoCo 柔性网格
双侧接触检查后夹持；抬起至少 32 mm 才能脱扣
脱扣 → 回收停靠 → 拉出 → 下压扣回 → 松手保持
受控螺旋收放边界，未标定卷簧动力学
原生柔性碰撞；静态预览也包含带身碰撞近似
默认物理录制；三维外观为静态预览

demonstration.title: 伸缩带完整操作 · MuJoCo 原生柔性仿真
demonstration.caption: 原生物理录制，包含端头局部放大。夹具采用接触检查后的约束夹持；卷筒采用受控收放边界。不是浏览器实时操作，也不是机器人自主操作。
